deviations.description: test-verify-deploy-gate-selection.sh and test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh must both be green
deviations.reason: test-verify-deploy-gate-selection.sh: fully green (9 passed, 0 failed). test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh: 14 passed, 1 failed -- root-caused definitively (not merely isolated via stash, as in the earlier Phase 2/3 notes): the suite's FIXTURE is git-init'd but never git-add's its rsync-copied content, so gate 22 (shellcheck lint)'s default git-ls-files-based enumeration finds zero tracked .sh files inside the fixture and exits 2, which verify-deploy.sh's gate 22 branch reports as a FAIL. Confirmed via direct reproduction (REPO_ROOT=FIXTURE bash lint-shellcheck.sh --verbose -> 'ERROR: no *.sh files found to scan') and via stash-isolation against the unmodified verify-deploy.sh (identical failure). Wholly unrelated to gate 3/4, this task's only scope. Logged as issue (pre-existing-test-defect, minor) with a recommended follow-up fix for that suite's own fixture construction.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- context-budget suite's baseline-fixture failure root-caused to a pre-existing, unrelated fixture defect (missing git-add before gate 22's git-ls-files enumeration); see Phase 6 verification notes)*
